svg.title: Fleet Vehicle Buys: Hammer, All-In, and Market
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-fleet-vehicle-price-ranges; chapter number: 2; title: Fleet Vehicle Buys: Hammer, All-In, and Market; subtitle: Reported price spans on retired fleet, fire, and police units; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: USD; bars: label: Expedition buy to cash in; min: 900; max: 2000; typical: 2000; display: $900 buy, about $2,000 cash in; label: Expedition KBB; min: 5000; max: 5500; typical: 5000; display: $5,000 to $5,500; label: F-250 hammer to all-in; min: 4150; max: 4669; typical: 4669; display: $4,150 hammer after 47 bids; $4,669 with fees; label: Explorer white vs black; min: 5000; max: 6600; typical: 5000; display: White around $5,000; black $6,600; label: 2019 AWD Charger hammer; min: 3570; max: 3570; typical: 3570; display: $3,570 hammer, maybe $2,000 profit; caption: Buyer premiums run about 5% on GSA Auctions, up to 10% on GovPlanet, and up to 15% at sheriff auctions; set a KBB-based stop price before the first bid.; assumptions note: Typical values mark a reported point within each span; the Charger profit is the speaker's estimate, not a realized sale.; note: Attributed to Tool Demos (EFXJtp6q_B8), UX Auctions (IUAs4NGQfyo), Street Rat Garage (6chXsHCTJA4, qieQr_fEJQ8), and Top 5 Autos (WFVGJDWST7I).
